result.title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
result.summary: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-α}$, where $α=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($α\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($α\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

AI.brief_summary: 研究自回归 transformer 生成 t 个 token 后还剩多少 prompt 信息：用同一续写、不同 prompt 的隐藏状态距离刻画影响，证明其按 t^{-α} 幂律衰减（α 由注意力稀释与 relay 传递决定），并给出深度 L、长度 P 的界，用可解线性模型与 logit bias 实验说明该界不可改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「prompt 影响随生成被稀释、relay 只能补对数因子」的机制与反事实 prompt 对的度量方式，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否随推理步数衰减、latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息（纯文本设定需迁移）。
